question: What do users think of the sidebar?

prompt.system:
You are a research assistant for the product team at Tessera, an all-in-one workspace app.
Answer the researcher's question using ONLY the retrieved records provided. Records are customer complaints and changelog items.
Cite the record IDs that support every claim in square brackets, for example [C054] or [R12-01].
If the records do not contain enough information to answer, say so.
prompt.user:
Retrieved records:

id: C061
source_type: complaint
product_area: editor/pages
title: Teamspace grouping wastes space in the sidebar
text: Half my sidebar is teamspace headers. I just want a simple list of pages like before.

---

id: R16-01
source_type: changelog
product_area: editor/pages
title: Compact sidebar layout
text: Your sidebar, your way

Based on your feedback since 3.0, you can now switch to a **compact sidebar** that shows all of your pages in a single flat list, similar to the layout before the redesign.

**What's included**
- All pages appear in one alphabetical or manually ordered list, without teamspace headers
- Favorites remain pinned at the top
- A small colored dot next to each page shows which teamspace it belongs to
- Drag and drop still works for reordering pages and moving them under other pages

**Good to know**
Teamspace grouping remains the default for new members. Switching layouts only changes how the sidebar looks for you. It does not move pages or change any permissions. Toggle between layouts in **Settings → Appearance → Sidebar**.

---

id: R01-01
source_type: changelog
product_area: editor/pages
title: Redesigned sidebar
text: A cleaner home for your workspace

The sidebar has been rebuilt from the ground up. As workspaces grew, a single flat list of pages became hard to scan, so we reorganized it around how teams actually work.

**What's new**
- Pages are now grouped by **teamspace**, with each teamspace collapsible on its own
- A dedicated **Favorites** section sits at the top, so the pages you open most are always one click away
- **Private** pages live in their own area below your teamspaces
- Drag a page from one teamspace to another directly in the sidebar to move it

**What's changed**
The old flat page list has been retired. Existing pages were sorted into teamspaces automatically based on where they were shared. Pages that were not shared with any teamspace now appear under Private.

**Good to know**
Workspace owners can reorder teamspaces for everyone in **Settings → Teamspaces**. Individual members can still collapse or hide teamspaces they don't use.

---

id: C008
source_type: complaint
product_area: editor/pages
title: Sidebar sections keep expanding after reload
text: Since the new sidebar came out, I collapse the teamspaces I never use and they all pop open again the next time I load Tessera. With 14 teamspaces this makes the sidebar useless.

---

id: R02-01
source_type: changelog
product_area: editor/pages
title: Sidebar remembers collapsed sections
text: Sidebar fixes and polish

Since 3.0, some of you noticed that sections you collapsed in the sidebar would expand again every time you reloaded Tessera. The sidebar now remembers which teamspaces and sections you collapsed, and keeps them that way across sessions and devices.

We also fixed two smaller sidebar issues:
- Dragging a page onto a collapsed teamspace now expands it after a short pause, so you can drop the page in the right spot
- The Favorites section no longer flickers when a favorited page is renamed by someone else

The sidebar layout itself has not changed in this release.

---

id: C014
source_type: complaint
product_area: editor/pages
title: Bring back the old flat page list
text: The teamspace grouping in 3.0 might work for big companies, but I'm a team of three. I liked seeing all my pages in one list. Please give us the option to go back.

---

id: C071
source_type: complaint
product_area: mobile
title: Tablet app is just a stretched phone app
text: On my Android tablet the app looks like a blown-up phone screen. The sidebar disappears when I open a page and split screen doesn't work.

---

id: R16-03
source_type: changelog
product_area: billing and plans
title: Upgrade prompts limited to admins in Business workspaces
text: Your sidebar, your way

Members of Business workspaces will no longer see upgrade prompts in the sidebar, in the page menu, or when they try to use a feature from a higher plan. Many members can't make purchasing decisions for their workspace, so these prompts were more distracting than helpful.

**What's changed**
- Upgrade prompts now appear only to workspace owners and billing admins
- When a member tries a feature from a higher plan, they see a short note explaining that it's not included and an option to **Ask an admin**
- Admins receive these requests in a single weekly summary email, grouped by feature

This change applies to Business workspaces only. Free and Plus workspaces continue to show upgrade options to everyone. The checkout itself is unchanged.

---

Question: What do users think of the sidebar?

answer:
Based on the provided customer complaints and product records, users have expressed several key opinions and frustrations regarding the sidebar:

* **Frustration with Teamspace Grouping & Desire for a Flat Page List:** Users complained that teamspace headers wasted space in the sidebar [C061] and that teamspace grouping was unnecessary for smaller teams [C014]. They requested the option to return to a simple, single flat list of pages [C014, C061, R16-01]. 
* **Issues with Collapsed Sections Resetting:** Users expressed frustration that collapsed teamspaces and sections would expand again every time they reloaded the app, making the sidebar difficult to use for those with many teamspaces [C008, R02-01].
* **Distraction from Upgrade Prompts:** Members of Business workspaces found upgrade prompts placed in the sidebar (and page menus) distracting, particularly because non-admin members could not make purchasing decisions [R16-03].
* **Mobile/Tablet Interface Issues:** Users on Android tablets reported that the sidebar disappears entirely when a page is opened [C071].
